PhD candidate in Statistics at UMass Amherst working on probabilistic
forecasting, Bayesian modeling, and time-series methods for infectious disease
surveillance, with industry experience in insurance analytics from data science
internships at Travelers and The Hartford.

## Education

**University of Massachusetts Amherst** — Amherst, MA
: PhD in Statistics, expected May 2027

  - Distinguished Teaching Award for Excellence as a TA/Discussion Leader (May 2025)

**East Tennessee State University** — Johnson City, TN
: M.S. in Mathematical Sciences, 2015

  - Thesis: [Comparison of Two Parameter Estimation Techniques for Stochastic Models](https://dc.etsu.edu/etd/2567/)
  - Outstanding Graduate Student Award

**University of Tennessee, Knoxville** — Knoxville, TN
: B.S. in Physics and B.S. in Mathematics <!-- TODO: graduation year -->

  - Research projects in experimental particle physics

## Research & Industry Experience

**Graduate Research Assistant**, Reich Lab, Biostatistics & Epidemiology, UMass Amherst
: Fall 2024 – present

  - Administrator and modeler for the [SARS-CoV-2 Variant Nowcast Hub](https://github.com/reichlab/variant-nowcast-hub):
    run weekly models, manage genomic surveillance data, and handle the
    operational work behind a collaborative modeling platform.
  - Probabilistic forecasting with Bayesian hierarchical, time-series, and
    machine learning models, including UMass model development for CDC
    [FluSight](https://github.com/cdcepi/FluSight-forecast-hub).
  - Developed WISAR6, a PyMC AR(6) + Fourier seasonality model fit with a
    WIS-loss Gibbs posterior in place of a likelihood, at the state and US levels.

**Data Scientist Intern**, Actuarial Strategic Modeling, The Hartford — Hartford, CT
: Summer 2026

  - Built a loss ratio prediction framework to improve understanding of
    portfolio profitability, risk segmentation, and underwriting opportunities
    across general liability.

**Data Scientist Intern**, Travelers Insurance — Hartford, CT
: Summers 2023 and 2024

  - 2024: Predictive modeling of property premiums using market-wide features,
    including AI model scores, aerial imagery, and property information.
  - 2023: Extended a LightGBM survival model for customer retention with
    aerial imagery features.
  - Won the 2022 Travelers Data Science Modeling Competition (predictive
    modeling of customer conversion).

[\* Co-first authors]{.footnote-note}

## Software

- [**fixedCV**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=fixedCV) (CRAN, 2026), co-author with Rebecca Kurtz-Garcia.
  Fixed-smoothing (fixed-b) critical values for inference under serial
  correlation or conditional heteroskedasticity.
  Simulation code: [fixedCVsims](https://github.com/trobacker/fixedCVsims).
- [**scoring-multiclass-props**](https://github.com/trobacker/scoring-multiclass-props).
  Research code on energy scores for evaluating probabilistic forecasts of
  multi-class proportions.

## Skills

- **Languages:** Python, R, SQL
- **Modeling:** Bayesian hierarchical models and MCMC, time series and
  probabilistic forecasting, forecast evaluation and proper scoring rules,
  generalized linear models, machine learning and predictive modeling,
  statistical methods in clinical trials
- **Libraries:** PyMC, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, h2o, pandas,
  Polars, GeoPandas, tidyverse
- **Tools:** Git/GitHub, Jupyter, RStudio, Quarto, LaTeX, MATLAB, Unix/Linux,
  AWS (EC2, SageMaker)
